findings.label: Unregistered-phone request throttle gap
findings.detail: /auth/otp/request only writes and counts rows in otp_login_codes for registered active users, so the resend-cooldown and max-per-window checks never fire for unknown phones; requests for non-existent numbers are unthrottled. Harmless with the shipped Noop sender (nothing is dispatched and registration status is not leaked), but an identity-independent throttle (per-IP or a request-attempt table keyed on phone regardless of user match) should be added before wiring a real SMS provider.

findings.label: Non-constant-time hash comparison
findings.detail: VerifyOTP compares the computed code hash to the stored hash with != rather than hmac.Equal/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare. This matches the pre-existing lifecycle-token convention in the module and the risk is low (keyed sha256, not a raw secret). Consistency note, not a blocker.
